quote.text:
It's crazy.
太不可思议了。

[Umpire announces the result]
【裁判宣布比赛结果】

[Shelton] is in the championship match of the 2026 US Open.
谢尔顿晋级2026年美网决赛。

And what a pity it had to end on a double fault.
遗憾的是，比赛竟以一次双误结束。
